planted_defects.description: Cache key `user:{user_id}` omits tenant_id, so different tenants with the same user_id collide (cross-tenant data leak / wrong result).
cache.set(key, user) stores None when the user is not found, poisoning the cache (subsequent real lookups return None).
list_orders_with_users calls get_user() once per order inside a loop, an N+1 query pattern (was a single join before).
No tests were added for the new get_user cache behavior or the new loop path.

notes: The rename getU -> get_user is a legitimate improvement, not a defect. Security section MUST be 'No issues found.' Any concrete security vulnerability claim is a false positive.
